answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the velvet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the thread re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
